[[Leather Square]]s are a rare crafting material used in the crafting of a number of armor sets.

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Select [[artisan]]s will craft one Leather Square for 5 [[Tanned Hide Square]]s and 50 {{gold}}.
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Leather Squares.
** See [[:Category:Contains leather]] for other items.
* No [[creature]]s currently appear to [[drop]] [[:Category:Drops leather|Leather Squares]].
